####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: Try just one model to see if it works 
####################################################################################################

# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")

args_pat <- "multi_men"
dose <- if(args_pat %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", 
                           "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_mmr")) "v1" else "vl"
```

# Read the data ----------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
args_dat <- glue("data_brms_{args_pat}_{dose}_s08.rds")
dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modfit}/{args_dat}"))
```

# Retrieve your model formula from the command line arguments ------------------
```{r}
l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modfit}/formula_brms_{args_pat}_l.rds"))
args_fo <- names(l_formula)[[1]]
```

# Retrieve the iters from the command line arguments ---------------------------
```{r}
args_iter <- 3000
# Add criterion? 
crit <- FALSE
```

# Run the models ---------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# Run the models ---------------------------------------------------------------
mod <- brm(formula = l_formula[[args_fo]],
             data = dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
             warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
             init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
             save_all_pars = TRUE)
if(crit == TRUE) mod <- add_criterion(mod, criterion = c("waic"))
```

# Check it ----------------------------------------------------------------------
```{r}
# plot(mod)
# conditional_effects(mod)
# play_mod
# stancode(mod)
```

####################################################################################################
END
####################################################################################################







```{r}
dat_long <- readRDS("../outputs/modfit/data_brms_multi_men_long_vl_s08.rds")
l_formula$bmvl_s08_multi_men_base_gauss
```


# Test 
```{r}
set.seed(200)
sample_pid <- sample(unique(dat$pid), 200)

# Original 
mod0 <- brm(formula = l_formula$bmvl_s08_multi_men_base_gauss,
  data = filter(dat, pid %in% sample_pid), family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Gaussian model: Works
mod1 <- brm(formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + vac_conc + 
    (1 | study) + (1 | study:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1,
  data = filter(dat_long, pid %in% sample_pid), family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
```

```{r}
# Adding fixed effect by sero type: works 
mod2 <- brm(formula = bf(
  imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + vac_conc + 
    (1 | study) + (1 | study:center:rct_group) + time_v1_v2 + time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1 + imm_sero_s1),
  data = filter(dat_long, pid %in% sample_pid), family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
```


```{r}
# Adding fixed effect by sero type and re(pid): works
mod3 <- brm(formula = bf(
  imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + vac_conc + 
    (1 | study) + (1 | study:center:rct_group:pid) + time_v1_v2 + time_v2_v3 + time_vl_s1 + imm_sero_s1),
  data = filter(dat_long, pid %in% sample_pid), family = gaussian(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = args_iter, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
```


